svg.text: Appointment–Service M:N is resolved by APPOINTMENT_SERVICE; historical and partial-payment structures are included

text.tspan: M:N resolution: APPOINTMENT_SERVICE is the bridge.
Historical price: SERVICE_PRICE_HISTORY stores effective periods;
Partial payments: one BILLING record can have many PAYMENT rows;

svg.text: Legend: underlined = key | dashed underline = partial key | dashed oval = derived | double outline = weak / multivalued | gold rectangle = associative | (min,max) = participation
